tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cream. The page, in the app, on the site and on the bag.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, sheets and menus: anything that sits on the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Fog. Wells, the track of a segmented control, the tab bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy, on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, hints and metadata, on every surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decoration only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control: fields, the secondary button. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta. The one action a view is for, and where you are: the primary button, the current tab.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Terracotta as text, and the primary button when pressed. Reads on every surface and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: A wash behind accent-strong text: the New tag, a selected row.

tokens.name: accent-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, 2px away from the control. An alias, so it moves with accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Copy on a forest fill: toasts, the bag label.

tokens.name: on-honey
tokens.usage: Copy on a honey fill. Always ink, in both themes.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The brand's deep green. Fills that carry copy: toasts, the bag label, a switch that is on.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: A wash behind text-success: the In stock tag.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Marks that say fine: the roast meter, a check, the sprig. Never body copy in the light theme.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: The empty dots of the roast meter and other quiet tracks.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: First Light's own color. Seasonal highlights and the Limited tag, a little at a time.

tokens.name: honey-soft
tokens.usage: A wash behind ink copy for seasonal notes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and actions that cannot be undone. Deeper than accent, so the two differ in lightness, and always with words.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: A wash behind text-danger: the Paused tag.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links in running copy, underlined. Follows accent-strong.

tokens.name: text-success
tokens.usage: Good news in words: In stock, Delivered.

tokens.name: text-danger
tokens.usage: An error message under a field. Follows danger.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: The serif says things: names and headlines, always at regular weight, so size alone sets the order. No web font: the stack falls back to faces every reader already has.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page or screen: a launch headline, the cover.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Roasted Thursday, at your door by Saturday

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and the name of a coffee.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The system sans does things: copy, labels and controls.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Apricot, jasmine and a little honey. A light roast for slow mornings.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and the description of a coffee.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We roast every Thursday and ship the same day, so the bag you open is days old, not months.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels. Sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Change or skip a delivery until Wednesday noon.
styles.usage: Hints, metadata and the small print under a field.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: A short line above a title. The only uppercase in the system.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Numbers that line up: prices, weights and dates in lists.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Prices, weights and order numbers, wherever digits should align.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Inside a component use space-1 to space-4; between components space-5 and up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a field and its hint; the gap in a row of tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A button's vertical padding; rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on a phone; the page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on wider screens; between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the groups of a form.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a display headline.

radius.note: Soft, never bubbly. The smaller the thing, the smaller its corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, the thumb of a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the blocks on the cover.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switches and the roast meter's dots. Nothing else is fully round.

shadow.note: Borders before shadows: a card gets a line, and a shadow only once it floats above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The thumb of a switch or a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus and a card that is being dragged.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Toasts and sheets: what floats over everything else.

motion.note: Things settle; nothing bounces. Wrap every transition in prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press states.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: A switch, a tab underline, a toast arriving.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and anything that crosses the screen.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: The default curve: quick out, slow to rest.
